media.creator: Creator

media.noteBody: The differences visible here are those the nature of the title imposes — director and runtime for a movie, creator, status and catalogue for a series. Any other difference would be drift.
media.followWaitsForKind: Title type unknown — the follow is waiting to know whether it is a movie or a series.

profile.noteBefore: My first version of this screen set “accepted sources” and CAM/TS exclusions that
profile.noteAfterCode: actual one has only the four fields below. The rest — the weights that break ties — is global and already lives in
profile.leadAfter: : it eliminates what will never do. It does not order — what survives is separated by the global ranking.
profile.minResolutionHint: A floor, not a list: everything below it is excluded. “No floor” lets through sources with no readable resolution (REMUX, COMPLETE.BLURAY), which the ranking scores on merit.
profile.audioHintBefore: No selection = no language filter. A release must carry
profile.exclude3dHint: An SBS / Over-Under release is unwatchable on a 2D screen. On by default: it is a correctness floor, not a taste.
profile.requireKnownResolutionHint: By default we let it through: a name that cannot be parsed is most often a REMUX, not a bad file.
profile.rulenote: If this profile no longer accepts any torrent, the follow reports it and its search answers “no torrent found”.
profile.saveToast: Profile saved — the next search will apply it.
profile.inForce: In force: {{floor}} — the highest quality requested by those who can choose it.

add.searchAria: Search for a title to add
add.emptyBody: Your recent searches are above. The search starts on submit.
add.tvdbHint: A TVDB ID contains only digits. If TVDB cannot resolve it, the follow will be created but episode detection will stay unavailable — and you will be told.
add.idRefusedImdb: “{{typed}}” is not an IMDB ID: it starts with “tt”, followed by digits.
add.idRefusedNumber: “{{typed}}” is not a {{prov}} ID: it contains only digits.
add.idWaiting: “Add” becomes active as soon as a {{prov}} ID is entered.
add.idMissing: No title found for the {{prov}} ID “{{typed}}”.
add.idOwned: “{{title}}” is already in your library: search for it by title to replace it.

resolution.noPosterTitle: No poster at the provider for this candidate.
resolution.tieNote: candidates come out with the same score. The ranking cannot decide — which is why the question is put to you.
resolution.noteTitle: Resolution is a screen, not a panel.
resolution.noteRest: the list being read: on a phone, you never saw it.
resolution.noMediaIdentified: No title identified. Here is what the providers suggest for this name.
resolution.plexHeld: Plex recognised it as “{{title}}”. If it is the right one, choose it; otherwise, look for the right identity.
resolution.noCandidates: The providers returned no candidate for this name. There is nothing to choose: manual search is the only way.
resolution.emptyBody: Manual search opens pre-filled with the folder name.
resolution.note2Title: Leaving as is does not mean ignoring.
resolution.note2Body: It means “later”: the folder stays on the machine, set aside, folded at the end of “To handle” — out of its count, never forgotten. You pick it up from there whenever you want.
resolution.settledHint: What has already been decided, so you do not answer twice — and so you can find what you chose.

reasonDetail.below_threshold: No candidate reached the automatic confidence threshold.
reasonDetail.mid_band: The best candidate was at medium confidence — a human check is requested.
reasonDetail.ambiguous: Several candidates were too close to decide automatically.
reasonDetail.manual: Folder sent by hand from the preparation area.

decisionStateDetail.resolved: A candidate was chosen, and a targeted rescrape was launched.
decisionStateDetail.dismissed: The folder was left as is: the automatic result is kept, nothing was rescraped.
decisionStateDetail.superseded: A more recent version of the folder has been rescraped since. This decision no longer means anything.

system.introLead: System answers a single question: is the machine doing well?
system.introRest: A blocked title is not here — it waits for your hand in “To handle”, on Acquisition. What you find here are the processes, the scheduled passes, the room that is left, and the code that raised an error.
system.faultRest: This machine is green everywhere, and a screen that can only be green cannot be judged: this state replays a fault to show what you would see the day something stops. Nothing here is read from the system.
system.schedulerLead: A scheduler between two passes is not stopped.
system.schedulerRest: PM2 calls it “stopped”, which is the truth about the process and a lie about the system: seven red lines on a machine in perfect health. A service is judged on “is it running”, a scheduler on “did it run”.
system.schedulerLateLine: every hour at minute 15 · last pass 3 days ago · 71 missed passes
system.toAcquisition: The pipeline is driven from here, with its levers; what it does to a title is read on its card, in Acquisition.
system.toMaintenance: Repairing what the index reports is done from Maintenance.

unavailableLine.services: The state of the services could not be read.
unavailableLine.disks: The room on the disks could not be read.
unavailableLine.index: The health of the index could not be read.
unavailableLine.dependencies: Redis and the providers could not be queried.

system.settingsSubtitle: What the pipeline does, and how — including the time of the scheduled passes. Grouped by what you want to change, not by file.
system.serviceDownLine: stopped since 14:02 · exited with an error
system.pipelineGuidance: These settings apply to every title at once.
system.lockStaleLine: The file is there, the process that took it is no longer running: nothing can start while it remains.
system.toLocksRepair: Removing what a crash left behind is done from Maintenance.
system.pipelineQueued: Requested — this pass waits for the maintenance in progress to finish.
system.automaticTriggerDown: Stopped by a technical fault: it is not answering.
system.automaticTriggerOff: Finished downloads no longer open a pass by themselves.
system.runsDegraded: This list may be incomplete — the passes database did not answer.
system.runRunningJustNow: running for less than a minute

run.title: A pass
run.noLog: Output not kept for this pass.
run.notFound: This pass does not exist or is no longer recorded.

library.incompleteNoteMiddle: The fraction shown here reads the same computation as the sheet and the season headers. A season whose episode count is unknown shows
library.recentTitle: Seen by the index for the first time
library.recentNoteMiddle: The database does not know the date a title arrived on disk, only the one on which
library.recentNoteEmphasis: the index first saw the title
library.recentNoteEnd: . That is therefore what the page says — §13: no state shown is a silent approximation.
library.mediaNoteMiddle: No route listed what you own: the sheet
library.mediaNoteEnd: could only be reached by already knowing the ID. In list mode, a swipe to the left reveals “Delete”.
library.loadingNoteLead: Loading: infinite scroll, because here it is free.
library.loadingNoteEnd: , locally: another page of 24 costs neither quota nor external network. The count line above always says how many are shown out of the total — §8, we never hide what is missing.
library.emptySearchBody: The search ignores case and accents.
library.emptySearchNarrow: The category filter may be too narrow — try “All”.
library.emptySearchElsewhereLead: This title may not be yours:
library.emptyCategoryEnd: , but this mockup only carries the 260 most recent titles — this category is not among them.
library.emptyIncompleteBody: “Incomplete” only lists the series with missing episodes.
library.endMark: End of the sample — this mockup loads {{count}} real titles out of the 1,861 in your library. In real life, scrolling would continue to the end.
library.loadErrorRest: The connection was lost during the request. The {{count}} titles already shown remain valid.
library.filterMeta: Each category with the number of its titles.

acquisition.nowNoteLead: “In progress” view — what moves, on its own.
acquisition.nowNoteRest: One section, “In flight”. What waits to be grabbed is grabbed from the follow's sheet; what has arrived is read in the Library's “Recent”; what found nothing is read on the follow; what is blocked is “To handle”.
acquisition.followsNoteLead: Delivered view, taken up to the letter.
acquisition.followsNoteRest: Three modes (list · grouped · grid), dot pill on a 20 % tinted background, meta line = fraction then status then figure caption, no subtitle: the year lives in the sheet. The 12 follows shown are yours, with their real state.
acquisition.cadenceNoteLead: A flaw this take-up brings to light.
acquisition.cadenceNoteBefore: The cadence is displayed as the scheduler returns it —
acquisition.cadenceNoteAfter: . A cron expression on a phone card is raw jargon: NE-DOIT-PAS-4. To be translated into “twice a day, at 3:20 am and 3:20 pm”.
acquisition.discoverNoteRest: Recommendations live here because they lead to “Follow” — the action of the (+) right next to it. The bar's badge never counts them: they wait for nothing from you.
acquisition.callsNoteLead: The TMDB calls are off the thumb.
acquisition.gesturesNoteBefore: The poster opens the sheet. The rest of the card opens the bottom panel (“Follow” / “Add”, “See the sheet”). A swipe
acquisition.gesturesNoteAfter: dismisses the suggestion — with an “Undo” in the notification, because a quick gesture gets it wrong.
acquisition.tmdbMissingNoteLead: If the TMDB account is not connected
acquisition.tmdbMissingNoteRest: , the view does not go empty: it serves the similar titles of your library and says what is missing and why. §8 — no silent nothing.
acquisition.errorTodo: what is waiting for your hand
acquisition.followFilterMeta: Followed series and movies, with their count. Paused ones stay apart.
acquisition.followSortMeta: Urgency first: new follows, then what needs a grab or is moving, then what is waiting, then what is up to date. With no known release date, a follow comes last.
acquisition.emptyFilterBodyAfter: follows, none carries this name. The filter ignores case and accents.
acquisition.emptyNoFollowsBodyAfter: at the bottom right adds a movie or a series.
acquisition.tmdbBefore: Without it, two things are missing: your
acquisition.tmdbMiddle: — so we cannot know what you have already seen without owning it — and the personalised recommendations TMDB computes for you.
acquisition.tmdbAfterBreaks: The view does not go empty for all that: below, the
acquisition.tmdbEnd: of what you own, filtered against your library and your follows. It is less fine-grained, and it says so.
acquisition.callsNoteBefore: A background pass — like the watch — pages through TMDB at a civil pace, filters against your library, your ratings, your follows and your dismissed titles, then stores the survivors in a local reserve. Measured on your real data:
acquisition.callsNoteAfter: . The screen reads the reserve, so scrolling costs nothing any more — which is what makes batches of 30 possible without ever bursting (NE-DOIT-PAS-8).
acquisition.todoEmptyBody: What is moving is in “In progress”.
acquisition.todoTunnelError: A step does not go through

todoFilter.step: A step does not go through

acquisition.todoFilterMeta: Each cause with the number of its cards.
acquisition.todoSortMeta: Urgency first: what awaits your judgement, then what resumes on its own, then what is closed.

install.label: Install the app
install.line: Adds it to your home screen: it opens like an app, without the browser's bar.

ios.label: Install the app
ios.line: Safari has no install button: adding it to the home screen is done by hand.

update.label: A new version is ready
update.line: It replaces this one and reloads the app.

accountPage.noteLead: This account, its role and what it can do.
accountPage.noteRest: Rights belong to the role, never to the account: what is missing here is granted by changing role, in “Accounts”.
accountPage.identifierSub: set in the configuration, not here
accountPage.transportSub: the cookie is only sent over a secure connection
accountPage.whereSub: the session IS the cookie; signing out asks the server to let go of it, and the screen only reflects what has already happened
accountPage.roleSub: only one per account; its rights are yours
accountPage.forbiddenHere: forbidden on this instance, for every account
accountPage.noRight: No right: this role opens nothing here.

language.heading: Language
language.label: Interface language
language.line: The same on all your devices; your notifications are written in this language.
language.refused: The language could not be changed.

notifications.heading: Notifications
notifications.intro: Your choices apply to all your devices. Only the types your role lets you follow are offered.

device.label: This device

granted.line: The types ticked below arrive on this device.

unasked.line: This browser has not given its permission yet: the ticked types arrive on your other devices, not on this one.

denied.line: Permission was refused: restore it in this browser's site settings to receive notifications here.

needs-install.line: On iPhone and iPad, notifications only reach the app added to the home screen (Share, then “Add to Home Screen”).

unsupported.line: This browser does not receive notifications: your choices apply to your other devices.

device.failed: Turning on did not go through: try again in a moment.

notifications.refused: “{{type}}” was not changed: the server refused the request.

owner.line: Owner of the Plex server: the fallback password is used when Plex is not answering. It can only be changed by a command on the server, never here.

plex.line: This account is linked to Plex: it has no password here.

local.line: Local account: your e-mail address is not a user of the Plex server. Your password is changed below.

password.heading: Password
password.changed: Password changed: it applies from your next sign-in.
password.mismatch: The two new passwords are not the same.
password.refused: The change was refused: nothing was changed.

notFound.title: This address leads nowhere.
notFound.bodyAfter: — a link has aged, or the address was retyped. Nothing is broken for all that.

maintenance.introLead: What we DO to the library.
maintenance.introRest: System says whether the machine is doing well; here you act on what it contains. The commands are grouped by what you want to do, never by the file they live in.
maintenance.journalNote: The {{total}} destructive operations the library has undergone. All were written by the pipeline itself, none by a hand: a log that only recorded the operator would be a log nobody opens.

query.title: Look
query.explanation: Read the state of the library. Nothing is modified.

scan.title: Index
scan.explanation: Go through the disks and bring the index back in line with them.

repair.title: Verify and repair
repair.explanation: Check the files, and empty the repair queue.

clean.title: Clean the disks
clean.explanation: Remove what has no business being there. These commands delete.

fix.title: Fix
fix.explanation: Straighten out wrong data: a link, a count, an identifier.

analyze.title: Analyze
analyze.explanation: Understand what the library contains, and what it lacks.

settings.noMatchBody: Search by what the setting DOES — “space”, “threshold”, “language” — or by its key name.
settings.readOnlyRest: This instance changes nothing — it is staging, which writes to the same disks as production.
settings.restartRest: will only take effect at the next start of the service.
settings.secretsSubtitle: API keys and passwords. You can see that they are set, never what they are worth.
settings.secretsHint: You can see that a key is set, never what it is worth.
settings.secretsNoteRest: A field left empty erases nothing: only a key actually entered goes to the server, otherwise opening this screen and saving would be enough to erase everything.
settings.rankingSubtitle: What makes one release preferred over another. Adjusted with a live preview, hence a screen of its own.
settings.mapNoteLead: We navigate by what we want to change, never by file.
settings.mapNoteRest: The engine keeps nineteen of them; knowing which one holds the minimum disk space before an ingest is knowledge of the code, not of the library. Every setting says where it comes from — that is what you need to read a log — but it is not the map.
settings.conflictRest: The file changed on disk while you were editing it: what is on screen no longer describes what is saved. Nothing was written.
settings.restartConfirmBody: The service stops and starts again. It is unavailable for a few seconds — for every account in the house, not only you, and an acquisition in progress will resume where it stopped.
settings.restartDone: Service restarted — the settings are in effect.
settings.leaveBodyOne: {{count}} change is waiting to be saved. What should happen before leaving {{page}}?
settings.leaveBodyMany: {{count}} changes are waiting to be saved. What should happen before leaving {{page}}?

noAccess.title: This account opens no page.
noAccess.body: Its role gives it no right here: the administrator can assign it another one in “Accounts”.

gate.title: Sign in
gate.subtitle: Access to your library and your acquisitions.
gate.plexUnreachable: Plex is not answering: sign in with a password.
gate.plexPending: Waiting for Plex: confirm the sign-in in the Plex page that has just opened.
gate.doors: Account linked to Plex: come in with Plex. Local account: come in with your e-mail address and password.

accounts.oneRole: An account has a single role; its rights are the role's.
accounts.notOwnRole: Your own role cannot be changed from here: another manager does it.
accounts.adminRole: The Admin role holds no list: it bypasses every right, present and future. It can be neither restricted nor modified.
accounts.refused: Refused: this change goes beyond your rights, or would leave the server without an Admin.
accounts.name: Name
accounts.plexHint: An address that is a user of the Plex server is linked: the account comes in through Plex only, with no password. Any other address makes a local account, which comes in with the temporary password given here and then changes it in its Profile.
accounts.nameRequired: A role has a name: it cannot stay empty.
accounts.createBeyond: Refused: this starting role goes beyond your rights.

signInKind.owner: Plex owner: Plex and fallback password

accounts.demoted: Linked to Plex: its role went back to the starting one. To be promoted again (before: {{role}}).
accounts.demotedShort: starting role since its Plex link

defaultFor.plexHome: Starting role of the Plex Home users of the Plex server, at their first sign-in or when they are linked.
defaultFor.plexGuest: Starting role of the other users of the Plex server, at their first sign-in or when they are linked.

reset.hint: Replaces a forgotten password. Pass it on to the person: they will change it in their Profile.
reset.done: Temporary password saved: pass it on to {{name}}, who will change it in their Profile.
reset.adminOnly: Only an Admin resets a password. Everyone changes their own in their Profile.
reset.own: Your own password is changed in your Profile, with the current one.

access.lockedOwner: Plex server owner: their access is never cut.
access.lockedOwn: Your own account: its access is not cut from here.
access.cutDone: {{name}}'s access cut: their sessions are closed.
access.restored: {{name}}'s access restored: they can sign in again.

roleCreate.title: New role
roleCreate.lead: A role carries a name and the rights it gives every account that holds it. Nothing is created before « Create the role ».

accountCreate.title: New account
accountCreate.nameRequired: An account carries a name: it is required.

roleDelete.heading: Delete the role « {{name}} »?
roleDelete.body: No account holds it and no new account starts on it. The deletion is final.

accounts.adminOwnerOnly: Only the Plex server's owner promotes an account to Admin.
accounts.ownerStaysAdmin: The Plex server owner's account stays Admin: otherwise nobody could give the Admin role back.

reasons.piece_length_mismatch: The candidate's pieces are not the same size as the original's.
reasons.file_list_mismatch: The candidate's file list differs from the original's.
reasons.root_name_mismatch: The candidate's folder does not have the same name as the original's.
reasons.v2_hybrid: The original is in v2 or hybrid format, which cross-seed does not support.
reasons.self_candidate: The candidate found is the original itself.
reasons.fetch_failed: The candidate's .torrent file could not be downloaded from the tracker.
reasons.verify_timeout: The file verification did not finish in time.
reasons.magnet_not_supported: The tracker only offered a magnet link, which cross-seed does not support.
reasons.inject_failed: qBittorrent refused to add the torrent.
reasons.obligation_write_failed: The torrent was added, but its sharing obligation could not be recorded.
reasons.creation_failed: The torrent could not be created from the original's files.
reasons.publish_failed: The tracker did not accept the publication of the torrent.

waits.switchOff: the tracker's cross-seed switch is off
waits.trackerOff: the tracker is disabled: nothing is searched or published there
waits.trackerDown: the tracker is disabled by a fault: nothing is searched or published there

line.offRunning_one: Cross-seed: off on this tracker — {{count}} torrent continues
line.offRunning_other: Cross-seed: off on this tracker — {{count}} torrents continue

panel.uploadOff: Publish here: {{tracker}} does not accept uploads
panel.stoppedBySwitch: stopped on {{date}} — the tracker's switch cut the cross-seeds in progress
panel.stoppedByCut: stopped on {{date}} — cut from this torrent
panel.excluded: Excluded from the engine's next passes
panel.titleExcluded: Title excluded: no more cross-seed, on any tracker.
panel.none: No other tracker is eligible for the cross-seed of this torrent.
panel.queued: Queued — the search is waiting its turn in the engine
panel.uploadQueued: Queued — the publication is waiting its turn in the engine
panel.quota: Searches today: {{used}} of {{perDay}} · at most one every {{delay}} min

switch.engineOff: The cross-seed engine is off: no tracker starts a new one, what is running continues.
switch.onDetail: The engine searches and injects cross-seeds there.
switch.onEngineOffDetail: Switched on for this tracker, but the engine is off: it neither searches nor injects anything there.
switch.offDetail: No new cross-seed here any more; those in progress continue until they are stopped.
switch.offStoppedDetail: No new cross-seed here any more, and those that were running have been stopped.
switch.label: Cross-seed on {{tracker}}
switch.nextPass: Takes effect on the engine's next pass.
switch.uploadsOnDetail: A torrent can be created and published there from a torrent being shared, where no cross-seed was found.
switch.uploadsOffDetail: No torrent will be published there; those already published continue.

card.plexMatch: Plex recognised it as “{{title}}”, not as this title.

closure.torrent_removed: The torrent was removed from qBittorrent: this journey is closed.
closure.files_absent: Its files have disappeared from qBittorrent's disk: this journey is closed.
closure.superseded: Replaced by a more recent choice: {{winner}} is in place.
closure.reopens: If it comes back, a new journey will open.

error.body:
The server did not answer in time. Nothing is lost — what is shown
      elsewhere remains valid.

ladder.ratioWithoutThreshold: Deferred: the ratio on {{tracker}} is too low, and this tracker has no threshold set.

reasons.queued: Queued — this pass waits for the maintenance in progress to finish.
reasons.confirmation: The Plex match is waiting for your confirmation.
reasons.ratio_below_threshold: Deferred: the ratio on {{tracker}} is below its {{minimum}} threshold.
reasons.insufficient_space: Deferred: not enough space on the staging disk to receive it.
reasons.content_missing: Deferred: the disk where qBittorrent downloaded it is not readable.
reasons.library_full: No library disk has room to receive it ({{size}}).
reasons.tracker_unreachable: {{tracker}} is not answering: the torrent cannot be retrieved.
reasons.provider_unreachable: {{provider}} is not answering: identification is waiting.
reasons.plex_unreachable: Plex is not answering: the match cannot be verified.
reasons.client_unreachable: qBittorrent is not answering: the download is no longer tracked.

lifts.ratio_below_threshold: It resumes on its own once this ratio exceeds {{minimum}}.
lifts.insufficient_space: It resumes on its own once room is made.
lifts.content_missing: It resumes on its own once this disk is back.
lifts.library_full: It is shelved on its own once a disk has room.
lifts.tracker_unreachable: It resumes on its own once {{tracker}} answers.
lifts.provider_unreachable: It resumes on its own once {{provider}} answers.
lifts.plex_unreachable: The check resumes on its own once Plex answers.
lifts.client_unreachable: Tracking resumes on its own once qBittorrent answers.

ladder.liftWithoutThreshold: It resumes on its own once this ratio recovers.

reconnecting.title: Live updates: the connection was lost, reconnecting

refused.title: Session expired — sign in again to see updates
refused.body: Your session is no longer valid, so this screen no longer updates.

connection.waiting_one: One action is waiting to be sent to the server.
connection.waiting_other: {{count}} actions are waiting to be sent to the server.
connection.refusedOnSending_one: One action was refused by the server when sent.
connection.refusedOnSending_other: {{count}} actions were refused by the server when sent.

message.installRequested: Installation requested — the browser takes over.
message.installing: Installing — the icon is on its way to your home screen.
message.installRefused: Installation declined — the banner will come back on your next visit.
message.oneMoreBack: One more back to leave TorrentMate.

maintenance.destructiveNote: The dry run stays on as long as nothing has shown what would be destroyed: an “are you sure?” gets answered without reading, a list gets looked at. Run it dry, read what it names, then run it for real.
maintenance.runForRealHint: First read what the dry run names.

secret.neverReturned: The server never returns the value, so it is not shown here. We know it is set, we do not know what it is.
secret.removeConfirmBody: The key will be removed for every account of the household. This provider will stop answering until a new key is entered.

setting.nothingWritten: Nothing is written until the bottom bar is used. It says which files will be touched.
setting.cancelledToast: Change cancelled — nothing had been written.

sort.title: Sort the library
sort.note: The sort is a preference, not a location: it stays on this device and does not enter the URL (A7).

journey.provenanceNote: A step not yet reached shows “upcoming”.
journey.absorbedBy: This episode is covered by the retrieval of season {{season}}.
journey.absorbedEnded: Season {{season}} has arrived in the library.

notMedia.title: This is not a title
notMedia.meta: Where should “{{folder}}” be shelved? It leaves the acquisitions.

suggestion.filmLeavesNote: Once acquired, this movie will leave your list automatically.

add.ownedBefore: Already in the library — the acquisition

follow.noSeasonData: No season data known for this series — the catalogue has not been retrieved yet.
follow.foundNextPassAt: Found, will be grabbed on the next pass, at {{at}}.
follow.foundNextPass: Found, will be grabbed on the next pass.
follow.filmLeavesNote: Once acquired, this movie will leave your list automatically.
follow.readOnly: This acquisition belongs to another account: it can be read here, not driven.
follow.pausedForAll: Paused: every requester who can pause it has asked for it.
follow.pauseWaitsForOthers: Your pause is noted; the acquisition continues until the other requesters have paused it.

reassign.title: Reassign “{{title}}”
reassign.note: {{name}}'s request moves to the chosen account. Only the accounts that see this acquisition are offered.
reassign.empty: No other account sees this acquisition.

decision.correctHeld: Correction requested — waiting for the network.

correctRefused.gone: This identification is no longer on the server: there is nothing left to correct.
correctRefused.conflict: The state of this title has changed in the meantime: reopen its sheet and try again.

delete.exactly: Here is exactly what would be deleted:
delete.followedText: Unless you act, these episodes will be downloaded again on the next search.
delete.ambiguousText: One identifier is carried by several lines of the library: this is a duplicate. Settle it first — nothing is deleted until we know which of the two would go.
delete.keptSeedOwed: Seeding owed to the tracker until {{day}} at {{time}}
delete.keptSeedOwedUndated: Seeding still owed to the tracker
delete.keptDiskUnreachable: Its disk is not plugged in
delete.keptFailed: Removing one of its folders failed
delete.keptText: What is kept stays whole: its files, its library row and its Plex entry.

library.deleteRefused: The deletion was refused: nothing was deleted.
library.deleteHeld: The deletion will go as soon as the server answers.

acquisition.completionStarted: “{{title}}”: search for the missing episodes started.
acquisition.tmdbConnected: TMDB account connected — the reserve is filling up, your ratings are being read.
acquisition.identified: “{{target}}” identified as “{{title}}” — scraping resumes, no follow created.
acquisition.replaceMovieOwned: This movie is already in the library. The acquisition
acquisition.replaceMediumOwned: This title is already in the library. The acquisition
acquisition.replaceAfter: the version in place with the one that gets downloaded.
acquisition.replacementQueued: Added — the version in place will be replaced once the new one is downloaded.
acquisition.reclassified: “{{title}}” shelved in “{{destination}}” — it leaves the acquisitions.

abandon.heading: Abandon “{{title}}”?
abandon.bodyAfter: will be quarantined in staging and the move logged. Nothing is deleted.
abandon.bodyFollow: The follow continues: another release will be searched for.

deleteStaged.heading: Delete “{{title}}” from disk?
deleteStaged.bodyAfter: will be deleted from disk and the deletion logged.
deleteStaged.caseKeepsFiles: The torrent keeps its files in qBittorrent: this folder is only a copy of them.
deleteStaged.caseOnlyCopy: This is the only copy: no torrent keeps these files.
deleteStaged.caseUnknown: qBittorrent did not answer: this folder is treated as the only copy.

acquisition.left: “{{title}}” set aside — it is waiting for you, folded at the end of “To handle”.
acquisition.resolved: Identified as “{{choice}}” — the pipeline resumes through to the library.
acquisition.closureSeenRefused: “{{title}}” could not be marked as seen: its card stays in “To handle”.

media.seasonAsked: Season {{season}} of “{{title}}” requested — {{count}} episodes to download.
media.seasonAskedOne: Season {{season}} of “{{title}}” requested — 1 episode to download.
media.seasonAskedNone: Season {{season}} of “{{title}}” requested — no episode to download.
media.seasonAskedOneOff: Season {{season}} of “{{title}}” requested — follow it in “In progress”.
media.seasonAlreadyAsked: Season {{season}} of “{{title}}” already requested — it is being downloaded.
media.seasonHeld: Season {{season}} of “{{title}}” requested — waiting for the network, it will go out when it is back.
media.seasonRefused: Season {{season}} of “{{title}}”: the request did not go through.
media.rescrapeAsked: Metadata for “{{title}}” requested again from the providers.
media.rescrapeHeld: Rescrape of “{{title}}” requested — waiting for the network, it will go out when it is back.
media.rescrapeRefused: The rescrape of “{{title}}” did not go through.
media.rescrapeUnidentified: “{{title}}” has no provider identity: there is nothing to rescrape until it is identified.
media.seasonForbidden: Season {{season}} of “{{title}}”: your role does not give you the right to download it.

journey.requeueAsked: Requeued — the pass resumes where it stopped.
journey.requeueHeld: Requeue requested — waiting for the network.
journey.requeueRefused: The requeue did not go through.
journey.rescrapeAsked: Pass rescraped — the pipeline resumes from the scrape.
journey.rescrapeHeld: Rescrape requested — waiting for the network.
journey.rescrapeRefused: The rescrape did not go through.

follows.added: “{{title}}” added to your list — it appears at the top of “Follows”, marked New.
follows.followed: “{{title}}” added to your follows — it appears at the top of “Follows”, marked New.
follows.searchStopped: “{{title}}” will no longer be searched for.
follows.refused: “{{title}}” could not be saved: the server refused the request.
follows.forbidden: “{{title}}”: your role does not give you this right on this follow.
follows.actRefused: “{{title}}”: the change did not go through.

deck.spent: Reserve exhausted — all {{total}} loaded suggestions have been seen.
deck.refused: The loading did not go through.

releases.taken: “{{quality}}” chosen for “{{title}}” — follow it in “In flight”.

secret.replaceHeld: Key kept — it will be sent as soon as the network is back.
secret.replaceRefused: The key could not be replaced.
secret.replaceEmpty: Enter the new key before confirming.
secret.removeHeld: Removal kept — it will be sent as soon as the network is back.
secret.removeRefused: The key could not be removed.

system.watchLaunched: Watch launched — it is running, its result will appear in System.

maintenance.dryDone: Dry run finished — nothing was modified.
maintenance.held: Command requested — waiting for the network, it will go out when it is back.
maintenance.dryHeld: Dry run requested — waiting for the network.
maintenance.refused: The command did not go through.

remove.heading: Remove from qBittorrent?
remove.shared: The same files are shared on {{trackers}}: that sharing ends too.
remove.obligationBody: Removing it now closes it before it is fulfilled.

crossSeed.switchBody: The engine will no longer start new cross-seeds on {{tracker}}.
crossSeed.switchOffDone: Cross-seed switched off on {{tracker}}: no new ones, those in progress continue.
crossSeed.switchOffStoppedDone: Cross-seed switched off on {{tracker}}, and those in progress were stopped.
crossSeed.switchRunning_one: {{count}} cross-seed is running on {{tracker}}: it continues, unless you tick the box below.
crossSeed.switchRunning_other: {{count}} cross-seeds are running on {{tracker}}: they continue, unless you tick the box below.
crossSeed.stopRunning: Also stop the cross-seeds in progress for {{tracker}}
crossSeed.switchEnding: Ticked, this box ends these obligations, released:
crossSeed.obligationBody: Stopping it now closes it released, never in breach.
crossSeed.cutBody: The entry for “{{title}}” on {{tracker}} leaves qBittorrent, without its files: the original keeps its copy and keeps sharing on {{origin}}.
crossSeed.cutMemory: {{tracker}} is excluded from the engine's next passes for this title; undoing this lets it be searched again.
crossSeed.titleBody: The title is excluded from all the engine's next passes, on every tracker.
crossSeed.titleRunning: The cross-seeds in progress are stopped: {{trackers}} — their entries leave qBittorrent, without their files.
crossSeed.titleDone: “{{title}}” is no longer shared by cross-seed.
crossSeed.includeDone: {{tracker}} is no longer excluded for this title.
crossSeed.includeTitleDone: “{{title}}” can be shared by cross-seed again.
crossSeed.searchWaiting: Queued: today's quota is reached, the search will go out tomorrow.
crossSeed.searchDuplicate: A search is already queued for this cross-seed.
crossSeed.uploadHeading: Create and publish a torrent on {{tracker}}?
crossSeed.uploadBody: The engine creates a torrent from the files of “{{title}}” and publishes it on {{tracker}}, in your name, to open a cross-seed there.
crossSeed.uploadRules: {{tracker}} applies its own publishing rules: if it refuses, the torrent's line will say so, with its reason.
crossSeed.uploadRefused: {{tracker}} cannot receive this publication right now.
crossSeed.uploadsOffDone: {{tracker}} no longer accepts uploads: no torrent will be published there.

discover.allSeenRest: The {{count}} suggestions of the batch have been seen. The reserve holds more.
discover.allSeenRestList: The {{count}} loaded suggestions have been seen — more are waiting to be loaded.
discover.allSeenRestExhausted: All {{count}} loaded suggestions have been seen — the reserve is exhausted.
discover.endOfReserve: End of the reserve loaded in this mockup — {{loaded}} of the 503 suggestions actually computed for you. The background pass computes more after each new TMDB rating.

access.reservedBody: This account is not allowed to {{right}}.

quality.own: choose the quality of its acquisitions

library.read: Every role holds it by default.
library.delete: By default, only the Admin role holds it.
library.rescrape: By default, only the Admin role holds it.

acquisition.request: By default: Admin, Household member and Plex guest.
acquisition.follow: By default: Admin, Household member and Plex guest.

pilot.own: By default: Admin, Household member and Plex guest.
pilot.any: By default, only the Admin role holds it.

see.others: By default, only the Admin role holds it.

quality.own: By default: Admin and Household member.

pause.own: By default: Admin and Household member.

acquisition.reassign: By default, only the Admin role holds it.

todo.view: By default: Admin and Household member.

pipeline.control: By default, only the Admin role holds it.

trackers.view: By default, only the Admin role holds it.
trackers.control: By default, only the Admin role holds it.
trackers.upload: By default, only the Admin role holds it.

system.view: By default, only the Admin role holds it.

configuration.view: By default, only the Admin role holds it.
configuration.write: By default, only the Admin role holds it.

accounts.manage: By default, only the Admin role holds it.

access.ceilingEvery: This instance is read-only: no write is allowed on it, for any account.
access.ceilingSome: This instance forbids, for every account: {{rights}}.

request.invalid: The request is malformed: nothing was changed.
request.cross_origin: Request refused: it does not come from this interface.

route.unknown: This action does not exist on this server.

refusals.internal: The server hit an error: try again in a moment.

auth.required: Your session has ended: sign in again.
auth.refused: Sign-in refused: check your e-mail address and password, or come in through your account's own door.
auth.plex_only: This account signs in with Plex: it has no password here.
auth.rate_limited: Too many attempts: try again in a few minutes.
auth.access_disabled: Access cut: an Admin turned off this account's sign-in.

right.missing: Your role does not hold the right to do this.
right.not_own: This is not yours: your role only acts on what you requested.

instance.read_only: This instance is read-only: nothing is written to it.
instance.forbidden_write: This instance forbids this write, for every account.

account.email_taken: An account already uses this e-mail address.
account.admin_untouchable: An Admin account can only be changed by an Admin.
account.last_admin: Refused: the server would be left without an Admin.
account.access_admin_only: Only an Admin cuts or restores an account's access.
account.owner_access: The Plex server owner's access is never cut.
account.own_access: Your own access is not cut from here.
account.admin_owner_only: Only the Plex server's owner gives the Admin role.
account.owner_admin: The Plex server owner's account never leaves the Admin role.

role.system_immutable: A system role cannot be renamed, and the Admin role cannot be modified.
role.own_role: Your own role cannot be changed from here: another manager does it.
role.escalation: Refused: this change goes beyond your rights.
role.name_required: A role carries a name: it is required.
role.name_taken: Another role already carries this name.
role.in_use: An account holds this role: it cannot be deleted.
role.default: New accounts start on this role: it cannot be deleted.

plex.unreachable: Plex is not answering: sign in with a password.
plex.server_unreachable: TorrentMate's Plex server is not answering: sign in with a password.
plex.token_refused: Plex refused the sign-in: try again.
plex.pin_unknown: This Plex request no longer exists: try again.
plex.pin_expired: The Plex request expired before it was confirmed: try again.

password.current_wrong: The current password is incorrect: nothing was changed.
password.required: A local account gets a temporary password: it is required.
password.too_short: The password needs at least {{minimum}} characters, with an uppercase letter, a digit and a special character.
password.too_weak: The password must be at least {{minimum}} characters long, with an uppercase letter, a digit and a special character: one of them is missing.
password.held_by_cli: This fallback password can only be changed by a command on the server, never here.
password.reset_admin_only: Only an Admin resets a password: yours is changed in your Profile.
password.reset_own: Your own password is changed in your Profile, with the current one.

media.not_found: This title is unknown: the library no longer holds it, or its provider does not know it.
media.ambiguous: One identifier designates several lines of the library: settle the duplicate before deleting.

provider.unavailable: The metadata provider is not answering: try again in a moment.

library.locked: The pipeline is running: the library cannot be modified while it runs. Try again when the run ends.
library.obligations_unreadable: The seeding obligations cannot be read: nothing is deleted while what a tracker is still owed is unknown.

generic.title: TorrentMate
generic.body: Something new is waiting for you in the app.

seed_time.title: Obligation fulfilled
seed_time.body: {{title}} on {{tracker}}: the required seed time is reached.

ratio.title: Obligation fulfilled
ratio.body: {{title}} on {{tracker}}: the required ratio is reached.

removed_here.title: Obligation released
removed_here.body: {{title}} on {{tracker}}: removed from qBittorrent through TorrentMate.

breached.title: Obligation breached
breached.body: {{title}} on {{tracker}}: the deadline passed without the obligation being met.

ratio_low.title: Low ratio on {{tracker}}
ratio_low.body: The ratio on {{tracker}} has dropped below its alert threshold.

disabled.title: {{tracker}} disabled
disabled.body: TorrentMate switched {{tracker}} off after an error. Open Trackers to see it.

met.label: Obligation fulfilled
met.description: A torrent has seeded for the time or ratio its tracker requires.

released.label: Obligation released
released.description: A torrent left qBittorrent, through TorrentMate or outside it.

breached.label: Obligation breached
breached.description: A torrent's deadline passed without its obligation being met.

ratio_low.label: Low ratio
ratio_low.description: A tracker's ratio drops below its alert threshold.

disabled.label: Tracker switched off
disabled.description: TorrentMate switches a tracker off after an error (credentials refused, host unreachable).

failed.label: Cross-seed failed
failed.description: A cross-seed fails — never a mere absence of a match.

arrived.label: Arrivals
arrived.description: A followed movie or episode arrives in the library.

to_handle.label: To handle
to_handle.description: An acquisition is waiting for your decision.

disk_full.label: Disk almost full
disk_full.description: A disk drops below its free-space threshold.

service_down.label: Service unreachable
service_down.description: A provider or a service is no longer answering.
